tools.name: api_onesource_io_chain_erc20_balance
tools.description: ERC20 token balance for any Ethereum wallet - USDC, USDT, DAI, or any token - via balanceOf (eth_call) on OneSource live Ethereum RPC 0.003 USDC a call.

tools.name: api_onesource_io_chain_block_number
tools.description: Latest Ethereum block height - current chain tip via eth_blockNumber 0.001 USDC a call.

tools.name: api_onesource_io_chain_live_balance
tools.description: Live wallet balance - native ETH plus up to 20 caller-supplied ERC20 tokens in one bounded RPC batch 0.003 USDC a call.

tools.name: api_onesource_io_contract_address
tools.description: Best-effort contract introspection via batched RPC - bytecode presence, token metadata, and ERC20-like/ERC721/ERC1155 classification 0.005 USDC a call.

tools.name: api_onesource_io_chain_erc20_transfers
tools.description: ERC20 Transfer logs via eth_getLogs - raw Transfer events for a token or wallet 0.005 USDC a call.
